applies_to: OpenML 1597 v1 creditcard.arff, chronological 60/20/20 split as saved in split_manifest.json

decision.decided_by: ChatGPT (independent reviewer), relayed by the user
decision.scope_note: Approves the evaluation policy only. ChatGPT had not inspected the implementation or verified the review packet when it made this decision.
decision.primary_evaluation: Keep the chronological train, validation and test partitions unchanged. Evaluate all 56,962 chronological test rows with their observed class distribution.
decision.secondary_evaluation: Also evaluate the test rows whose exact V1..V28 + Amount vector appears in neither training nor validation. Label: 'previously unseen feature-vector subset'.
decision.model_and_thresholds: One model fitted on training rows only. Thresholds selected on the full validation partition by the declared validation-F1 rule (ties: highest threshold). The same fitted model, baseline score and thresholds are used for both test populations. No second model and no second threshold.
